welcome: 👋 Hi, {name}! I'm TaklifnomaBot — I make lovely invitations and help you send them to any chat. Everything happens right here, inside Telegram 💌
fallback: 🤔 I didn't get that. New invitation — /new, your list — /mine, help — /help.

create.choose_type: 💌 What kind of invitation are we making?
create.ask_eyebrow: ✏️ Write a small heading (eyebrow) — the short line at the very top of the message. For example: “You're invited” or “A special day”
create.ask_message: 📝 Write the main message. For example: “We'd love to have you with us on the happiest day of our lives!”
create.ask_question: ❓ Pick a question or write your own:
create.ask_allow_no: 🙅 Allow a “No” answer? “Yes” — the message gets a “No” button too (though it won't give up easily 😏). “No” — only the “Yes 💖” button.
create.ask_guest_pick: 📍 Let the recipient pick the place and time? “Yes” — you give options, they choose. “No” — you set the exact place and time yourself.
create.ask_places: 📍 Tick the place options (several allowed), then tap “Continue”:
create.ask_times: 🕐 Write the time options — one per line. For example: Saturday, 18:00 Sunday, 12:00 Monday, 19:30
create.preview_title: 👀 This is how the invitation will look in a chat:
create.confirm: All good? Tap 💾 Save, or go back to fix something.
create.saved: ✅ Done! Now in any chat type @{bot} in the message field, pick this invitation and send it. Or tap “↗️ Send to a chat” below.
create.err_times_count: ⚠️ Write 1 to {max} time options (one per line).
create.err_time_long: ⚠️ Each time option must be at most {max} characters.
create.expired: ⌛ This step has expired. Start again with /new.

help: ℹ️ TaklifnomaBot — quick guide 1️⃣ /new — create an invitation: type, heading, text, question, place and time. 2️⃣ Check the preview at the end and tap 💾 Save. 3️⃣ Open any chat and type @{bot} in the message field — your saved invitations show up. Pick one and it's posted to the chat with its buttons. 🔎 Example: In a chat with a friend you type @{bot} → pick “💞 Date / meetup · 05.10.2026” → your friend taps “Yes 💖” → picks a place and time → you get a notification right away 🎉 💡 @{bot} #12 — only invitation #12; @{bot} cinema — search by text. 😏 The “No” button doesn't give up easily — only after 10 taps… 📋 /mine — your invitations, responses and deletion 🌐 /start — change language
